answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 26536 Country: India Title: My wife gets vry angry on silly things......her temper gets very high and some of the times she often asks for talaq in anger.....there were my faults also....i gave her talaq only once..Can u please tell me any dua or tasbeeh that might help to calm her in her life and also is there some islamic book on relation and manners of sex in islam? Question: assalamu alaikum wa rahmatullahi wa barakatahu my wife gets vry angry on silly things......her temper gets very high and some of the times she often asks for talaq in anger.....there were my faults also....i gave her talaq only once..Can u please tell me any dua or tasbeeh that might help to calm her in her life and also is there some islamic book on relation and manners of sex in islam???? Thank you Answer ID: 26536 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1512/1512/M=1431) You should recite لا حول ولا قوة الا بالله seven times after reciting ta'awwuz (اعوذ بالله) and tas'miyah (بسم الله), and blow on water and give it to your wife to drink, or let your wife know this practice so that she could do it herself. Fatawa Rahimiyah deals with the method of intercourse in detail; also, you can study other books like "Poshida Raz" and "Tanhai Ka Sabaq". Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
